newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Foreign income from Russia govt paper not taxable.
newsitem.headline: Foreign income from Russia govt paper not taxable.

text.p: Non-residents' income from investment in Russian GKO Treasury bills and regional securities are not subject to tax, a senior central bank official said on Friday.
First deputy chairman Sergei Alexashenko told Reuters the explanations received by the central bank from the federal tax service and the finance ministry clarified taxation rules.
"The explanation lifts one of the most painful problems in relations between non-residents and the central bank," he said.
But he said capital gains from interest-bearing paper -- as opposed to T-bills, which are sold at a discount -- were liable for taxation in the same way as for Russian investors.
Alexashenko said the central bank had asked for an explanation from the tax authorities after a decree on income tax collection was published last Thursday.
